}}'''Shanelle''' is an [[Altaran]] [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Yellow Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Shanelle|comp}}

== Appearance ==
Shanelle is slender. She has pale blue eyes and a dark, pretty face.{{ref/book|6|30}}

==Strength and Abilities==
Shanelle has a [[One Power]] strength of {{opsl|38}}, making her [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|weak]] for an Aes Sedai. She would be unable to [[Travel]] without linking with another sister.

Although she was not particularly strong, [[Healing]] was her best Talent by far, and she had a very good ability with it.{{ref||comp}}  

==History==
She was born not far from Ebou Dar, although we do not know how old she is.{{ref||comp}}

She sometimes flirted with men, but was all business with her Warder.{{ref||comp}}

== Activities ==
She has allied herself with the [[Salidar Aes Sedai]].

She is present in the [[Little Tower]] when [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] [[Healing|Heals]] both [[Siuan Sanche]] and [[Leane Sharif]] of [[stilling]] completely shocking everyone. Shanelle suggested that a smooth touch on the Healing would be better.{{ref/book|6|30}}
